description: This is a Python script for detecting text file encodings, usable via command line. It processes file inputs, analyzes their byte content to determine encoding, and outputs the results.

classes.name: UniversalDetector
classes.description: A class responsible for detecting character encodings from byte streams, imported from a relative package.

methods.name: Optional[str] description_of( lines: Iterable[bytes], name: str = "stdin", minimal: bool = False, should_rename_legacy: bool = False, )
methods.description: Determines and returns a string describing the probable encoding of given byte lines, or just the encoding if minimal is True.

methods.name: None main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Handles command line argument parsing and orchestrates the encoding detection for input files or stdin.
